web_service.title: Powerpal web service
web_service.description:
Both options are off by default. Turning either on makes the integration contact the Powerpal web service (powerpal.net) with this device's serial number and hardware ID.

Download: fetches readings the phone app uploaded in the past (up to 90 days) and merges them into the history. Readings from the device always take precedence.

Upload: sends this device's readings to your Powerpal account, as the phone app does, so the app and website stay up to date. It only uploads minutes the service does not already have, at most 1,000 per request and one request every 5 minutes. This writes to your account.

error.start_in_future: The start time can't be in the future.
error.too_old: That is further back than the readings we still hold (older energy is folded into a running total).
error.bad_range: 'Until' must be after 'Applies from', and the factor must be at least 1.
